Short Information : University of Allahabad has released the notification for the post of Professor, Assistant Professor and Associate Professor. This recruitment has been issued for 317 posts. Online applying process for Allahabad University Teaching Recruitment 2025 has started from 11 April 2025 & the candidates can apply till 02 May 2025. Candidates must check the complete details for Allahabad University Teaching Recruitment 2025 which has given below. 

University of Allahabad

Allahabad University Teaching Recruitment 2025

  • Exam Date : Notify Later

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 2000/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 1000/-
  • All Category PH : Rs. 100/-
